I'm starting to wonder if the children are manning checkpoints because the adults are shirking their duties...


Iran International English (@IranIntl_En)

A video published on social media appeared to show the Islamic Republic using a child at a military checkpoint, following earlier videos and reports of what were described as violations of legal rules and international conventions in Iran.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/IranIntl_En/status/2044760555970298162#m

I'm still thinking about what happened to Ahmadinejad. I heard a rumor from some folks that he met with Israelis in a neighboring country and was put under house arrest for that reason. 😳


Holly Dagres (@hdagres)

This was a wild read: "Ahmadinejad’s associates say the strike was in effect a jailbreak operation that freed the former president from regime control... regime elements immediately suspected that he had been spirited away to take part in a coup."
theatlantic.com/ideas/2026/0…




— h

"These are some things you don’t typically say when you have won, or are winning, a war: You don’t typically threaten to wipe out the other side’s civilization... Winning doesn’t typically require a scapegoat..."
wsj.com/opinion/for-now-at-l…

ICYMI: There was a prisoner swap between France and Iran.

Iranian national Mahdieh Esfandiari, convicted in France on charges of inciting terrorism, went back to Iran in exchange for imprisoned French hostages Cécile Kohler and Jacques Paris.
apnews.com/article/france-ir…

Deputy parliament speaker Hamid-Reza Hajibabaei: “When we have control over the Strait of Hormuz, no other country can impose sanctions on us. In this region, we were the only ones facing sanctions. Now . . . any country we decide will face sanctions.”
ft.com/content/f3c8decc-0c59…

Twitter is a confusing place.

On a single post, I’ll get called an apologist/regime lobby and a war-mongering CIA/Mossad asset.

If both sides are mad, I’m probably doing something right...
